items.title: Glover Compton Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: The interviewee compares Johnny Dodds to Jimmy Newton, noting Jimmy 'had the best business head' and 'was always up front on paper on the contract,' but does not describe a direct personal or professional interaction between himself and Jimmy Newton.

ctx.x: But Joe was the best going through a whole entire tune. He was tight.
How did the Johnny Dodds and Jimmy Newton compare? Oh, Jimmy Newton.

Well, Johnny Dodds was the best clarinet player. That's where everybody claimed, everybody couldn't be wrong. But Jimmy had the best business head. See, Jimmy was always up front on paper on the contract. Yeah. Yeah, he was always out front on the front. Be the leader. Yeah. You knew what everybody in the band was getting, but you never knew what Jimmy was getting, because he always signed the contract.
